title: American Integrity’s Ryan Hodges Receives PropertyCasualty360’s Excellence in Risk Management Award
summary: Senior Vice President of Risk Management recognized for advancing data-driven risk management, catastrophe analytics, and long-term financial resilience American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. (NYSE: AII) (“American Integrity,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”), a Tampa-based property and casualty insurance holding company and one of Florida’s leading providers of residential property insurance, announced that Senior Vice President of Risk Management Ryan Hodges received the Excellence in Risk Management Award in the Insurance Carriers category as part of PropertyCasualty360’s 2026 Insurance Luminaries Awards. This recognition honors professionals whose leadership, innovation, and commitment to excellence are helping to shape the future of the property and casualty insurance industry.
